question: which frozen mechanisms need pbp_participation and snap_counts, and when

pbp_participation.note: Per-play offensive and defensive participation. The input the P component is built from. Measured 2026-09-08: published and populated 2016-2025, 404 for 2026. Two accepted schemas -- 20 columns 2016-2022, 26 columns 2023

snap_counts.note: Per-player game snap counts, PFR-sourced. Measured 2026-09-08: published 2016-2025, 404 for 2026, one stable 16-column schema throughout. It carries NO pass/run split, so it cannot bound pass-play participation on its ow

required_by: targets_carries (the point forecast C is a prior share)
pbp_participation.why_week_1_is_safe: a week-1 forecast conditions only on PRIOR seasons. panel_p3 carries 2020-2025 and denom_panel carries team volume through 2025, so week 1 needs no 2026 participation at all.
pbp_participation.why_week_2_is_not: the accepted estimator is an EWMA with half-life 2 over the most recent games. From week 2 the most recent game is a 2026 game, and its pass_snaps come from pbp_participation_2026.
pbp_participation.current_state: published 2016-2025, 404 for 2026; WATCH_ONLY in the registry and never fetched by the capture workflow
pbp_participation.if_it_stays_unavailable: the estimator silently degrades to a stale prior -- last season weighted as if it were last week. That is a DIFFERENT estimator, so the correct behaviour is a named refusal rather than a quiet fallback.
pbp_participation.exact_refusal: PARTICIPATION_HISTORY_STALE, naming the newest ordinal present against the ordinal required
pbp_participation.alternative_registered_source: snap_counts is registered but is game-level totals with no play detail, so it cannot produce pass_snaps / team_dropbacks; it is not a substitute

required_by: nothing in the frozen non-QB chain

answers.can_historical_data_support_week_1_only: YES for week 1, NO from week 2
answers.is_another_lawful_source_already_registe: NO substitute for pbp_participation; snap_counts is registered but is the wrong granularity
answers.policy_change_made: NONE. The source policy was not altered to make this work; the debt is recorded instead.
